youtube.comment: What's the oldest animal you've ever heard of? 👇

beats.text: This shark could be older than the United States.
Greenland sharks live in the freezing waters of the Arctic.
In 2016, scientists dated them using the lenses of their eyes.
The biggest female was estimated at about 390 years old.
That makes it the longest-living vertebrate known to science.
They grow about one centimeter a year, and become adults at around 150.
Somewhere in the Arctic, a shark born before Mozart may still be swimming.
